how fast does com.example.app cold start
expected_behavior: runs am start -W multiple times, force-stopping before each cold run, and reports the median TotalTime
classifies the result against Android-vitals thresholds (cold excessive at >=5s)
notes that emulator timing is indicative, not device-grade

cases.prompt: measure how janky the scrolling is
expected_behavior: resets gfxinfo, has the app exercised, then reads the janky percentage and frame-time percentiles
warns when too few frames were captured to be meaningful
compares against the <1% good / 16.6ms-budget guidance rather than guessing

cases.prompt: profile the app deeply during startup
expected_behavior: captures a Perfetto system trace with no root and pulls it locally
does not claim to parse the protobuf trace itself — hands it to the Perfetto UI or trace_processor
points at the FrameTimeline for per-frame jank attribution

cases.prompt: does this app have a baseline profile
expected_behavior: reads dumpsys package dexopt for the compilation status
explains that speed-profile means a baseline profile is applied, and that verify right after install can be normal (cloud-profile dexopt queued)
does not conclude 'no profile' solely from a verify status
